title: Eiffel Tower
text: The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France. It was completed in 1889 and stands 330 meters tall.

title: Great Wall of China
text: The Great Wall of China is over 13000 miles long. Construction began more than 2000 years ago to protect against invasions.

title: Mount Everest
text: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level at 8849 meters. It lies in the Himalayas on the border of Nepal and China.

title: Louvre Museum
text: The Louvre Museum in Paris is the most visited museum in the world. It houses the Mona Lisa painting.

title: K2
text: K2 is the second highest mountain on Earth at 8611 meters. It is located in the Karakoram range.
